question: Which of the following is an example of a terrestrial biome?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Taiga**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Taiga**, also known as the **Boreal Forest**, is a type of terrestrial biome.
 
• It is characterized by **coniferous forests** consisting mostly of pines, spruces, and larches.
 
• The Taiga biome covers large areas of **North America, Europe, and Asia**.
 
• It has a **cold climate** with long winters and short, mild summers.
 
• The Taiga is home to a variety of wildlife, including **wolves, bears, and moose**.
 
• This biome plays a crucial role in the Earth's **carbon cycle** by storing large amounts of carbon in its trees and soil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Estuary**__

 __
 
• An **estuary** is a coastal area where freshwater from rivers and streams meets and mixes with saltwater from the ocean.
 
• Estuaries are highly productive ecosystems that provide habitat for a wide range of species, including fish, birds, and invertebrates.
 
• They act as nurseries for many marine species and help filter pollutants from the water.
 
 
 
• **Coral reef**__
 __
 
• A **coral reef** is a marine biome characterized by reef-building corals.
 
• Coral reefs are found in shallow, warm ocean waters and are known for their high biodiversity.
 
• They provide habitat for a wide range of marine species and protect coastlines from erosion.
 
 
 
• **Kelp forest**__
 
 
• A **kelp forest** is a type of underwater ecosystem formed by dense groupings of kelp, a type of large brown algae.
 
• Kelp forests are found in nutrient-rich, shallow waters along coastlines.
 
• They provide habitat and food for a variety of marine organisms, including fish, invertebrates, and marine mammals.
